scope: Manual operator runbook plus production read-only evidence verification for the one-time 10,000 GCA member benefit after support review and member ledger approval. The operator still signs and submits the transfer outside this system; this workflow never makes the benefit self-service claimable.

transferPolicy.registeredUserLimit: one member benefit transfer per approved registered user
transferPolicy.walletLimit: one verified Base wallet per registered user

approvalPrerequisites: controlled account record or manually reviewed registration packet exists
read-only ERC-20 balanceOf verifies at least 1,000,000 GCA at review time
member ledger record is active and links to a successful gca_holding_verification_v1 record
recipient wallet is the same verified Base wallet from the approved review
no prior member-benefit transfer evidence exists for the same member ledger
the transaction hash has not been recorded for another member

manualTransferSteps.label: Confirm review record
manualTransferSteps.operatorAction: Open the approved member review record and confirm registrationId, verified wallet, holdingStartDate, evidenceTxHash, evidenceTxHashFormatOk, holdingPeriodDaysVerified, and eligible status.

manualTransferSteps.label: Verify current balance
manualTransferSteps.operatorAction: Run a fresh read-only Base Mainnet ERC-20 balanceOf check for the verified wallet before preparing any transfer.

manualTransferSteps.label: Prepare reserve wallet
manualTransferSteps.operatorAction: Use the project or owner-held reserve wallet on Base Mainnet. Do not ask the user for private keys, seed phrases, custody, or fund transfers.

manualTransferSteps.label: Send member benefit
manualTransferSteps.operatorAction: Send exactly 10,000 GCA to the approved verified Base wallet. Confirm token contract and recipient before signing in the wallet.

manualTransferSteps.label: Verify and record transfer evidence
manualTransferSteps.operatorAction: After the wallet transaction confirms, run tools/record_cloudflare_member_benefit_transfer.py with the memberLedgerId, public transaction hash, reviewerId, reasonCode, and all three explicit acknowledgements. The production Worker reads the Base receipt and safe block, verifies the exact Transfer log, and writes the evidence record to D1.

manualTransferSteps.label: Close review
manualTransferSteps.operatorAction: The production evidence write sets memberBenefitClaimStatus to transferred only after receipt verification succeeds. Do not close or mark transferred from a screenshot or user-supplied statement alone.

safeClaims: GCA has published a manual transfer runbook for the one-time 10,000 GCA member benefit.
The transfer requires support review, an active member ledger, verified observed 30-day holding history, and manual reserve-wallet execution.

After a manual transfer, the production Worker verifies the successful Base receipt, safe block, official reserve sender, approved recipient, official token contract, and exact 10,000 GCA amount before storing evidence.
The benefit comes from the published project or owner-held reserve wallet only, not new minting.
The production route records verified public evidence and never signs, authorizes, or broadcasts a token transfer.
doNotClaim: the 10,000 GCA member benefit is self-service claimable today
holding 1,000,000 GCA automatically triggers a transfer
the production evidence endpoint can initiate, authorize, or sign the transfer
the member benefit is newly minted
the member benefit is cash, income, reimbursement, trading permission, voting control, lifetime access, price support, or a way to bypass risk controls
approval timing or transfer timing is promised before support and ledger review
